t: You're looking at Monolith, also called Empyrean, a sculpture by Barbara Hepworth. Hepworth was an English sculptor whose work exemplifies Modernism, and modern sculpture in particular. During the Second World War she was a leading figure in the colony of artists who lived in St Ives, alongside Ben Nicholson and Naum Gabo. This piece is one of her works standing here in London.
